context: Hi! How are you doing ?
I am good and you?
I am doing well! So, I see you're looking for movie recommendations. What was the last movie you watched?
Baywatch with Dwayne Johnson.
That's a great movie! The cast in it is great! Did you enjoy it?
I did, and I am actually currently listening to it in the background. Today has pretty much been a movie day for me.
That sounds wonderful. I wish movie days were every day. I personally like to watch movies every Tuesday with my roommates.
Nice, my girlfriend has been sick so we have watched several marvel movies and have now transitioned to non super hero movies. Haha
How fun, do you guys like the Avengers? What about Captain America Civil War? Definitely one of my favorites.
I do, my girlfriend is just now getting into them. I actually havent watched Captain America Civil War since it came out in theaters. I agree, it is a really good movie
Would you want to watch the trailer for Civil War? Definitely one to watch. I know you are transitioning into non-hero movies so I have another recommendation if you don;t want a hero movie.
whats your other recommendation?
Central Intelligence! Dwayne Johnson is in it and it's filled with action but also very funny thanks to Kevin Hart.
That actually sounds like a good one. Im not sure if I have seen that one yet.
Oh it's hilarious and one that'll keep you on your toes. Do you like Kevin Hart?
yes, i love his movies.
Good, you might enjoy this one, then. Do you care for ratings in movies? Or do you typically go with your gut?
Go with my gut. i have seen several poor ratings, but have loved the movie.
I am on the same boat! Everybody has different tastes and sometimes these Hollywood critics are mega harsh!
that is true.

context.content: Hi there! What kind of movies do you usually enjoy?
Hey! I'm into action movies. Prefer something thrilling and exciting.
Have you seen 'Pain & Gain' (2013)? It's a thrilling action comedy that follows the true story of a trio of conmen who recruit a muscle-bound handyman to help them commit armed robberies.
Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about the plot and the actors involved?
'Pain & Gain' is directed by Shane Black and stars Mark Wahlberg, Dwayne Johnson, and Anthony Mackie. The film is fast-paced and full of action sequences.
[END] The plot sounds like it could be right up my alley. Can you give me more details on the action scenes? I want to make sure it's intense and exciting.
